# HEM v0.8.1b3 — Distance-based arrival preparation

Home settings now lets you select residents by Home Assistant person or GPS tracker. Set the occupied radius and the preparation radius independently, in metres from the Home zone. Each defaults to zero (off).

When every selected resident was confirmed outside and the first resident returns inside the preparation radius, HEM starts the existing Prepare for arrival timer if the home is still Away. Entering the occupied radius takes precedence. Preparation respects cancellation, expiry, device permissions and room policies. Startup inside the radius does not start a new timer.

When window pause is enabled and a monitored room contact becomes unavailable, missing, unknown or reports a restored placeholder, HEM requests native OFF for running equipment under its power control. The usual device protections apply. Normal control can resume once all monitored contacts have reported closed for 60 seconds.
